text: Shell.jsx's <main> padding: var(--eb-space-6) is the single source of the page gutter on ALL FOUR sides (not just horizontal); PatternsCatalog.jsx, SdlcCatalogPage.jsx, and MainframeCatalogPage.jsx each additionally set their own page-level padding (var(--eb-space-8)/var(--eb-space-6)) on their outer wrapper, doubling the inset — same bug class as KnowledgeFlow.jsx's redundant space-4 padding (#533), fixed together in PR #535.

KB storage branch (env.knowledgeStore.repoRef.branch, resolved by resolveKnowledgeBranch in orchestrator/knowledge-sync.js) is a SEPARATE concept from a repository's code branch; normalizeKnowledgeStore's in-repo fallback must adopt only a repo's url+credentials (adoptRepoForKnowledge), never its code branch, or an unconfigured team silently pushes knowledge to the code branch. Default KB branch is 'agent-knowledge' (not protected).

Knowledge-learning settings (autonomy/review/promotion-gates) are rendered by ONE shared React component admin-console/src/components/KnowledgeLearningConfig.jsx (default export KnowledgeLearningSections; exports AUTONOMY_LEVELS/GATE_ORDER/GATE_LABELS/GATE_TIPS/KNOWLEDGE_LEARNING_DEFAULTS/PanelSection), consumed by BOTH the Knowledge-page slide-out panel (KnowledgeFlow.jsx, PUTs live) and the Team-Setup wizard Knowledge step (TeamSetup.jsx, mutates form state; readOnly in extend mode). Storage config is intentionally NOT in this component (KnowledgeFlow-only). Added in PR #579 (#567); don't reintroduce a divergent second copy of the copy/controls.

Role templates are a two-tier store (#587/PR#591): repo-seeded defaults in AGENT_TEMPLATES_DIR (wiped by make seed-templates) are overlaid by a durable user store USER_AGENT_TEMPLATES_DIR=/workspace/agent-templates; admin-console read loaders listAgentTemplateIds/loadAgentTemplate are overlay-aware (user file shadows default), so UI create/edit/delete of role templates survives a re-seed and is picked up by wizard/Flow picker without redeploy.
gh pr edit --remove-label can silently no-op on the first call (label reappears on next view); always re-verify labels with gh pr view --json labels after editing and re-remove if the label persists.

GET /api/auth/session (admin-console/api/auth.js ~192-196) returns only {authenticated, user:{username}} — NO role/scope/systemAdmin flag; so AuthContext.jsx (user={username}) and Shell.jsx (static NAV array, no role filter) can't hide admin-only nav/pages for non-System-Admins. Exposing caller role+memberships here is the frontend prerequisite for team-visibility gating (issue #584).

In the knowledge CLI (agent-image/scripts/knowledge), _git() prepends `git -C <checkout>`, so a caller can inject inline `-c user.name=...`/`-c user.email=...` via its args to set committer identity per-commit (valid `git -C <root> -c ... commit`), mirroring gh-as-agent commit — committer email is agent-<id>@ace.local while the author marker stays <id>@agents.local for poller loop-protection.

The composed CLAUDE.md Skills section (prompt-assembly.js skillsSection) now injects each granted skill's SKILL.md `description` (name + one-line desc), resolved via resolveSkillSourceDir (agent→team→global, same tier as seeding); assembleClaudeMd stays pure by taking a caller-supplied skillDescriptions map read in buildAgentClaudeMd (orchestrator.js).

prompt-assembly.js interactionNote() preamble contains em-dashes (' — '), so a test asserting 'no ` — ` separator' must scope to the relevant section (e.g. md.split('## Skills')[1]), not the whole composed CLAUDE.md.

KnowledgeFlow.jsx PromotionDialog keys its copy off `aggregated = !suggestion.id (manual) || suggestion.source==='related'`; a SINGLE manual lesson still has aggregated===true, so combine-phrasing reads wrong — gate singular copy on `single = aggregated && (suggestion.lessonCount||memberTexts.length) <= 1`. manualSuggestionFrom(list) sets lessonCount=list.length and entryIds for any length>=1.

Promoting a knowledge lesson to a skill accepts an entryIds array of length 1 end-to-end: admin-console/api/knowledge-suggestions.js validatePromotion requires entryIds.length>=1 (not >=2) and api.js adHocCandidate dedups any length — no >=2 guard on the backend.

KnowledgeFlow.jsx: the Skills column nodes are graph.nodes.filter(kind==='skill') from buildKnowledgeGraph (knowledge-graph.js), which since #620/PR#623 dedupes skill records to ONE node per name (team-owned card wins, unions provenance entry-ids, sets node.alsoGlobal when a promoted-to-global copy coexists). PromotionDialog now takes a teamSkills prop = those same nodes as the single 'this team's skills' source for its team-tier extend dropdown; effective extend scope is derived from the selected target (global-pool file -> to:'global' via the team->global transition), not the tier chip.

KnowledgeFlow.jsx PromotionDialog eligible extend targets for tier==='team' now derive from teamSkills (graph skill nodes) rather than skills.filter(source==='team'), so adopted/promoted global skills visible in the column are selectable; effectiveTo is derived from selectedTarget.scope (not the tier chip) to send the correct to:'global' scope to the backend.

skill.json (content lineage: version/contentHash/history/origin) is a NEW sidecar distinct from provenance.json (knowledge lineage); the pure core orchestrator/skill-manifest.js is byte-identical-mirrored in admin-console/api/skill-manifest.js with a shared golden fixture (orchestrator/skill-manifest.fixture.json) + a two-sided guard test, same discipline as knowledge-digest.js (added #625/PR#636).

Startup backfill for skill.json lives in admin-console (app.listen callback) only — orchestrator mounts /template-workspace read-only and cannot write to the global pool. Agent-tier skills are stamped lazily on first GET /api/skills or GET /api/skills/:name/content read.

persistKnowledgeSummaries (#635) calls the full runConvergenceCollector (not a lighter write path), mirroring archiveKnowledgeEntry — this means a summary backfill can trigger auto-promotion side effects at autonomy >= 3, which is intentional but surprising if not expected.

Unified skill tier-transfer (#626/PR#638): ONE pure planner admin-console/api/skill-transfer.js (planTransfer/permitTransfer/requiredPermission/transferAction/resolveCollisionName/buildTransferOrigin) + ONE endpoint POST /api/skills/transfer replace scattered promote/lift/share. COPY_ACTION matrix: agent>team=lifted, team>team=shared, team>global=promoted, global>team=adopted; move stamps 'moved' but keeps semanticAction. /api/skills/promote (agent>global cell retired) + /api/skills/promote-to-global are now deprecated comment-only wrappers, dropped from UI.

/api/knowledge/share-to-team (ShareDialog, team→team) only copies SKILL.md — not the full skill directory — unlike POST /api/skills/transfer which does a full cpSync; migrating ShareDialog to the engine unifies this behavior.

For skill/KB flows in 314092, 'route the ShareDialog/lift path through the engine' (issue #626 §3) means BACKEND delegation — /api/knowledge/promote & share-to-team keep their KB work (LLM-re-synthesised SKILL.md, entryIds, convergence, candidate lifecycle, extend mode, #559 cleanup) and call the engine for the file write; it does NOT mean pointing the frontend at POST /api/skills/transfer, which does only a verbatim cpSync + origin-only stamp and would drop all that KB lineage/content.
gh-as-agent commit does NOT stage files (no implicit -a) — run git add <file> first or the commit reports 'no changes added to commit'.

Override-stranding fix (#627): orchestrator setTeamSkillActive on a DEACTIVATE calls planSkillSync with includeMembers:[] so override members get skip-override (files+config kept) — that strands the skill once the pool dir is deleted. The fix strips the name from each opted-in (includeMembers) member's own skillsOverride and removes its files, AFTER the main results loop, guarded against double-sync.

Knowledge live-feed (api.js): kbParseLine parses ANY JSON object (no event-type whitelist) and knowledgeLinks.matchesScope filters purely by event.teamId (team:<id> scope) / event.agentId (agent:<id> scope), global/'' sees all. So any new appendSkillFeedEvent-style event (skill-deleted/skill-restored/skill-transfer/activation) flows to the SSE stream with NO frontend change — but it MUST carry teamId (team tier) / agentId (agent tier) or the scope filter silently drops it for non-global subscribers.

GitHub Event Log session correlationId contract is trigger:<triggerId>:gh:<eventId> (stamped by agent-entrypoint.py _execute_inner). To match a session: active sessions carry a single correlationId; finished sessions carry a correlationIds[] SET (grouped by Claude session-id since #555). Match active first, else history, else show a non-blocking not-found banner (never a blank view).

admin-console/api tests can't run the full 'node --test' suite in the sandbox: auth.test.js fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND for express-rate-limit (auth.js:18) because there is no node_modules. This is a pre-existing environmental failure — verify a new suite by running only the dep-free test files touched, not the whole directory.

The repo now has CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml (added via PR #670 for #665) runs four jobs on every pull_request and push to main — orchestrator (node --test), admin-console/api (node --test), admin-console (vite build), agent-image (pytest, py3.12); all green.

A GitHub workflow with `on: workflow_dispatch` can only be manually triggered if the workflow file exists on the repo's DEFAULT branch — `gh workflow run <wf> --ref <feature-branch>` returns 'HTTP 404: workflow not found on the default branch' when the workflow lives only on the feature branch, so pre-merge burn-in of a not-yet-merged CI workflow requires landing it on main first (or the first post-merge nightly).

The admin-console backend POST /api/llm-endpoints already accepts authType / complianceAck / oauthFlowId — adding oauth-token (Claude subscription/Enterprise) Model Provider support to a UI flow needs NO backend provider-creation change. For oauth providers a pasted authToken WINS over a completed oauthFlowId login flow (drop the flow id when a token is pasted); creating an oauth provider requires an explicit single-user complianceAck.
work-items.js workItemDetail() returns 'runs' as the run-ROWS array (overriding renderWorkItem's numeric runs count) — callers wanting the count must use detail.runs.length, not detail.runs
